references.text: Tells how the Israelites made a golden calf and quickly turned away from the way the Lord had commanded them to go
Describes how Aaron made the cast calf that the Israelites worshiped
Moses saw the calf and the dancing, paralleling his seeing the people's sin here
The Lord's word to Moses that the people had acted wickedly and made for themselves a cast image
Moses took the calf, the object of sin, and destroyed it completely
The psalm reminds us that they made a calf at Horeb and worshiped a cast image
Nehemiah recalls that their fathers made for themselves a cast calf and said this was their god
Stephen's speech refers to how the Israelites made a calf and sacrificed to the idol
